summary: Counter-trend reversal at a proven weekly turning point: pin bar or inside bar false breakout on D1/H4 at a W1 level rejected at least twice. Recorded, never traded in 2.0.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: As you can see in the chart above, price are at a weekly resistance level, buyers were rejected twice from this level which indicates that the market is at a hot a point and it is likely to reverse.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: The pin bar was rejected from that level, and there is also the formation of an inside bar false breakout. This is a clear indication of a trend change.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: counter trend works if it is well mastered, it is a contrarian approach that requires experience, so if you are a beginner, i highly recommend you to stick with the trend

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: it is characterized by a very long tail that shows rejection

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: typically all pin bars have a very small real body and a long shadow.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: The Hammer candlestick is created when the open high and close are roughly the same price; it is also characterized by a long lower shadow

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: Professional technicians say that the shadow should be twice the length of the real body.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: Pin bars with longer tails are more powerful.

any_of.formation_bars: mother + inside + sweep candle within the next 3

BULL: first piercing candle k in 3..5 pierces below L1 only and closes inside [L1,H1]
BEAR: first piercing candle k in 3..5 pierces above H1 only and closes inside [L1,H1]

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: An inside bar is two candlesticks, the first one is called the mother candle, it is big and large, and the second one is smaller and it is located inside of the mother bar.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: the second small bar is completely contained by the first one which is the opposite of the engulfing bar pattern.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: This price action signal is formed when price breaks out from the inside bar pattern and then quickly reverses to close within the range of the mother bar.

sources.label: SOURCE_CHART
sources.quote: diagram: the false-breakout candle's wick pierces beyond the mother extreme and its body closes back inside

market_structure.note: the weekly level replaces trend agreement; own_state is recorded

level.definition: W1 live G4 zone, role RESISTANCE with >= 2 separate swing-high touches for a BEAR / role SUPPORT with >= 2 separate swing-low touches for a BULL, containing the extreme +- 0.10 * W1 ATR

entry.price: the first executable tick after the signal candle completes (BUY ask / SELL bid)
